## Self-help tools

The website includes guided breathing, eye movement, fractal grounding, Leaf on Stream, Butterfly Tapper, and Horizon Scan. These tools are educational supports and do not replace assessment or treatment by a qualified professional.

## Safety

For immediate danger or a medical emergency in India, call 112 or visit the nearest hospital. Do not use the website as a substitute for urgent care.
